# Packages allowed to publish to the XIOM registry. One dotted name per line;
# blank lines and '#' comments are ignored by the workflow.
#
# A published version is immutable forever, so this file is the readiness
# gate: add a name only when the implementation is real, not a placeholder.
#
# Criterion (2026-09-21 pass): the package has source functions with bodies
# (not declaration-only), no stub markers dominating, and no wholesale
# "FFI bridge not linked" error paths.
#
# Deliberately excluded until they have working implementations:
#   declaration-only (no function bodies):
#     xiom.bullet, xiom.libsodium, xiom.libuv, xiom.openal, xiom.ros2,
#     xiom.stb, xiom.wasmtime
#   stub body:
#     xiom.sql
#   no source in this repo (stdlib owns the module):
#     xiom.ffi
#   FFI bridge not linked (calls return "not linked"):
#     xiom.redis, xiom.postgres, xiom.libtorch, xiom.numpy, xiom.sqlite
#   registry policy:
#     xiom.std (stdlib repo), xiom.ecosystem (umbrella, excluded)
#
# Namespace audit (2026-09-23): a package may not share a module namespace
# with the stdlib. Removed from this list:
#   xiom.math, xiom.log, xiom.net, xiom.test
#       duplicates of stdlib modules (xiom.math/geom, xiom.log.*, xiom.net.*,
#       xiom.test.*) -> recommended deprecation, pending owner confirmation
#   xiom.core
#       distinct durable-storage functionality, but stdlib owns the xiom.core
#       namespace -> rename package and modules to xiom.durable first
